ShortDescription.Value: Generate additional native road-traffic requests for disposable-city stress testing.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA / EXPERIMENTAL — use a test city.
WHAT IT DOES Multiplies native random-road-traffic requests and sustains bounded additional request batches. Extra Trips counts submitted requests, not guaranteed visible vehicles.
HOW TO USE Open TSL, choose 2x, 5x, 10x or 25x/Gridlock to start a test. Select 1x or Stop / Reset to stop generation.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Stop/Reset cancels outstanding test-clone requests on the next simulation tick; vehicles already dispatched continue normally. Pause must be released for simulation cleanup to run. Vanilla pathfinding/dispatch determines visible traffic. Higher multipliers can hurt performance and are not fully runtime verified.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.5.5-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Stop/Reset and 1x now signal cancellation of queued test requests. Honor city-transition reset settings. Harden request counters and per-update queue limits; dispose command buffers reliably.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
